g.title: siphon
g.text: Find the selected Id library and runtime library directory.

g.title: prepare
g.text: Attach explicit native factories before calling id_init.
Validate contracts and retain the loaded libraries.

g.title: deps
g.text: Namespace; Object Model enumeration, epoch and key index
Method Observation; Root Registry; GC Settings
Native Stack; Native Mark; Allocation Budget
Collect phase state; Storage observation and identities
Storage deferred index; Dispatch Cache and Guard Verdicts

g.title: id
g.text: Construct the object/vtable universe, symbols and heap;
establish execution objects and native runtime state.
The primordial foundation is still implemented in Rust.

g.title: rungs
g.text: Native stack · Rust, with C/libtcc support
Exact SCRIPT_MODULES initialization order, left to right:
Some construction providers are prepared early;
their ordinary module_init still follows this order.

g.title: native
g.text: Open through the selected IdApi and call module_init.
Install native objects, methods and runtime services.
Keep successful library handles pinned for process lifetime.

g.title: connect
g.text: Wire runtime services and resolve isolate hooks.
Store backfillMirror records the existing object graph.
Obtain the canonical Codegen object for module loading.

g.title: selection
g.text: If absent/rejected, or BIRNAM_FORCE_SOURCE is set:
embedded Birnam source → record source → Codegen eval:
Its fallback compiles a temporary resumable dylib,
then loads it; it is not evaluated synchronously.
Both routes use the loaded Rust compiler/runtime.

g.title: manager
g.text: Register native kernel names and library directory;
ask Module for the authored modules’ dependency order.

g.title: bootstrap
g.text: Install derived libraries, configuration and concurrency policy.
stacklessControl installs resumable control methods last.

g.title: legend
g.text: Green: Birnam-authored modules (often compiled to dylibs)
Amber: image recovery on the already loaded runtime
Installed inventory: 53 native + 28 compiled Birnam libraries.
8 authored modules form the ordinary bootstrap.
The current Siphon remains a Rust host; native loading
has been modularized, but the runtime is not yet Birnam.

g.title: ready
g.text: prepare_execution sets the host’s live native GC stack anchor.

g.title: program
g.text: Run the selected program, CLI or REPL.
Module loads additional Birnam modules and dependencies
on demand through Codegen; projectPolicy is lazy.

g.title: image
g.text: Restore image state after the native stack and bootstrap.
Map stored compiled code or rebuild it;
reconnect recovered code and process-local services,
then run image main or enter the worker driver.
